name: Select

selectionModel.valueOwnership: The product/form owner is authoritative for committed value. A controlled implementation exposes value + onValueChange; uncontrolled wrappers MAY own temporary local value only when the product does not provide one.
selectionModel.commit: Selecting an enabled option commits that value immediately and closes the current presentation unless a native platform picker requires its standard confirmation behavior.
selectionModel.emptyValue: Empty is represented by no selected option plus placeholder text; V1 does not add a second clear button inside the trigger.
selectionModel.disabledOption: Disabled options remain readable when needed but MUST NOT receive selection, keyboard commit or press activation.

openStateModel.controlledApi: open + onOpenChange MAY be exposed when product orchestration needs controlled presentation state.
openStateModel.open: Opening sets expanded state immediately, preserves the current committed value and moves focus to the selected option or first enabled option in custom presentations.
openStateModel.close: Selection, Escape/back, explicit close or safe outside/scrim dismissal closes the presentation and returns focus to the trigger.
openStateModel.error: Error semantics remain authoritative while open; focus/open styling MUST NOT erase the danger border or associated error message.

bottomSheet.defaultUse: touch-first mobile when an anchored list would be cramped, occluded or difficult to scan
bottomSheet.behavior: The sheet is modal, uses safe-area padding, focuses the selected/first enabled option, commits on option selection, closes, then restores trigger focus.

anchoredListbox.defaultUse: keyboard/pointer-capable or wider environments with sufficient space around the trigger
anchoredListbox.behavior: Visually MAY borrow Menu surface treatment, but semantics MUST be listbox/option rather than menu/menuitem. Placement may flip to stay on-screen.

nativePicker.defaultUse: when a platform-native picker materially improves familiarity, input modality or accessibility
nativePicker.behavior: The adapter maps the same label, value, disabled and validation semantics to the native control and returns the selected value through the same Select contract.

keyboardContract: Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens a custom presentation.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move option focus; Home/End move to first/last enabled option where supported.
Enter or Space commits the focused enabled option.
Escape closes without changing the committed value and restores focus to the trigger.
Typeahead SHOULD be supported for anchored listboxes when option labels are textual and the option set is not trivially small.
accessibilityContract: The trigger MUST have an accessible name from its label, expose aria-expanded and aria-controls for custom web presentations, and set aria-haspopup to the actual popup type: dialog for modal Bottom Sheet presentations or listbox for directly anchored listboxes.
Validation text MUST be associated with the trigger through the target platform's description/error semantics; web uses aria-invalid and aria-describedby when applicable.
Custom option containers use listbox semantics and options expose selected/disabled state; do not use menu semantics for value selection.
Opening custom presentation moves focus predictably; closing always restores focus to the originating trigger unless navigation intentionally leaves the field.
Selection cannot depend on color or a checkmark alone; selected options remain readable through semantic state and accessible selected value.
structurePatterns: trigger looks like an outlined Input but has no text cursor; trailing chevron communicates disclosure
label sits above trigger; trigger contains value/placeholder + disclosure with an 8px internal gap
open state uses focused border and rotated disclosure while the real option presentation is visible

Select is one component contract across adapters: touch mobile normally presents a Bottom Sheet, wider keyboard/pointer contexts may use an anchored listbox, and native platforms may substitute a native picker
selection is single-choice in V1 and the product/form owner remains authoritative for committed value
usageHints: this is a complete single-select contract, not only a Picker Trigger
touch-first mobile defaults to a Bottom Sheet listbox when anchored options would be cramped; anchored environments may use a floating listbox; native picker adapters are allowed
the presentation MUST expose the current selected value, disabled options and a predictable close/return-focus path
selecting an enabled option commits immediately for custom single-select presentations and closes the presentation
must expose expanded state when open and preserve error semantics while open
use listbox/option semantics for selection; Menu remains an action component and MUST NOT be reused semantically as a Select option list
for searchable or very large datasets, compose an explicit search/collection solution rather than silently turning V1 Select into a combobox
doNotInvent: no trigger-only Select that claims open state without rendering a real option presentation
no custom dropdown styling baked into the trigger itself
no menu/menuitem semantics for value selection
no multi-select chips in V1 Select
no hidden second committed value inside the presentation adapter
no tiny chevron-only activation target; the whole trigger opens Select
no searchable free-text behavior unless the contract is explicitly extended to Combobox/Search Select
